title: Spiced lentil and carrot soup
summary: Spiced lentil and carrot soup is a middle eastern dinner built around dried red lentils and carrots, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Spiced lentil and carrot soup. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add dried red lentils and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and carrots.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until onions is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Spiced lentil and carrot soup before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Spiced lentil and carrot soup.
